messages.content: You are a senior security code reviewer.

Review handleStripeWebhook. Bug: it trusts req.body.event_type before verifying stripe_signature. Required fix: compute HMAC-SHA256 over raw_body using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, compare with timingSafeEqual, reject if timestamp skew > 300 seconds, and store event_id in webhook_events with unique constraint for idempotency. Retry should return 200 for duplicate event_id.
Webhook bug: verify stripe_signature before event_type, HMAC raw_body with secret, timingSafeEqual, 300s skew, unique event_id idempotency, duplicate returns 200.
